text:
rachel: FYI I hit a weird gap while doing the service token migration. we have org operator tokens and project API keys but no short-lived project delegation token that keeps provenance. leads to operator tokens being embedded in code or opaque project keys proxied through routers.
ken: sketch the problem with a tiny example?
rachel: current flow: svc-router calls downstream with project_key X or uses op_token Y. neither shows which svc initiated the call in a verifiable way. want a minting path: auth-service -> short-lived child token with parent reference + issuer proof.
sam: sounds right. what about embedding parent id and minted_by in the JWT claims so runtime verification is local?
rachel: prototype claim: 
```
{\n  "iss":"auth.redwood",\n  "sub":"svc:ingest",\n  "aud":"project:alpha",\n  "exp":1799016545,\n  "delegation_proof":"parent:op-12345|via:svc-router|trace:txn-987"\n}
```
ken: two concerns: TTL sizing (latency vs ops) and whether services will call auth for parent metadata on every verify (chattiness).
natalie: also need policy semantics: policy evaluation should prefer explicit delegation rights and only fall back to project keys. otherwise a bunch of services relying on project_key semantics will break.
sam: propose TTL defaults: 10m for task tokens, 24h for session tokens, overridable by issuance policy. to avoid chattiness, embed minimal signed parent proof and cache parent metadata in SDK.
rachel: also: audit ledger should record parent->child mappings async to keep runtime cheap. add retention TTL for compliance.
ken: rollout idea: (1) issuance + ledger + internal policy APIs, (2) SDK + local verification, (3) opt-in service checks, (4) enforced checks and deprecate long-lived operator tokens.
natalie: we'll need a compatibility shim so services accept delegated tokens while we migrate. platform QA will build test harness.
auth-bot: Draft RFC created: https://redwood.internal/rfcs/token-delegation-2026 (rachel) :white_check_mark:
rachel: I'll update the RFC naming: use "delegation_proof" claim to avoid future collisions. volunteers to review SDK + ledger retention?
ken: I'll review SDK.
sam: I'll take ledger retention.
natalie: I'll coordinate tests.
rachel: thanks all. I'll post the migration checklist and link it here when ready. :thumbsup:
